_comment: The built-in one-tap rule presets: product content, not user data, so it lives here instead of a seeded table - the public indicator pages serve it, and a public-site instance runs without a database. Text maps carry one entry per interface language (en, ru, be, uk, de, es, fr, it, pt-BR); a missing language answers English. 'when' is the RuleGroupDto fragment the rule constructor consumes with the ticker/exchange placeholders left empty for the client to fill. RulePresetCatalogTests guards the shape; adding a preset is a release change.
